title: China's goods surplus tops $1 trillion for a second year amid calls for Beijing to rebalance trade
summary_full: China's trade surplus topped $1 trillion as of October, potentially intensifying complaints from trading partners already wary over the glut of cheap Chinese goods.
summary_public: China's trade surplus topped $1 trillion as of October, potentially intensifying complaints from trading partners already wary over the glut of cheap Chinese goods.
